name: io.github.dav3trad3r/agentpickup
title: agentPickup
description: Find pickup shops near you, order, pay by card or USDC (x402), and get the QR to collect in person.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPICKUP_SHOP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The agentPickup shop to order from

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPICKUP_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key that pays over x402. Without it, pay_order only quotes

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPICKUP_MAX_PER_ORDER
environmentVariables.description: Most the wallet pays for one order, e.g. $25

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPICKUP_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CAIP-2 networks the wallet may pay on (default eip155:84532)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPICKUP_DIRECTORY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where find_shops searches (default the agentpickup.app directory); off to leave it out
